description: VERUS_SQL T6 final check: IN lists newly accepted by frontend v2 (PostgreSQL common type), with a one-row table because queries without FROM are refused, plus one table-backed empty-string/NULL/escaped-text bag (copy_text_edges has no tables, so the evaluator never ran it).

ddl.sql:
CREATE TABLE one (id integer NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE t (v text);

cases.name: in_common_type_bpchar
cases.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM one WHERE 'a' IN ('b'::char(1), 'a ')
cases.note: Common type bpchar (first typed item); both untyped literals become bpchar, so 'a ' equals 'a'. Frontend v1 typed this as text (false).

cases.name: in_common_type_numeric
cases.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM one WHERE '1.0' IN (2.5, '1')
cases.note: Common type numeric; 1.0 = 1 is true. Frontend v1 compared as text (false).

cases.name: text_edges_table
cases.note: Stored text: duplicate '', NULL distinct from '' and from the two-character text \N, embedded newline/tab/backslash, a single blank.
